name: Single constructor at end after control parameters
setup: $TC p4template create pipeline/constructorRules pipeid 22 numtables 1
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template create extern_inst/constructorRules/DirectCounter/c1 instid 1 tc_numel 4 tbl_bindable control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2 constructor param type ptype bit32 id 1 0 2>/tmp/p4tc-constructor-$TESTID.err
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/constructorRules/DirectCounter/c1 | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; value=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(value)==1; obj=value[0]; assert obj["extinstname"]=="c1" and obj["extinstid"]==1 and obj["num_elems"]==4; assert sorted((p["name"],p["id"],p["type"]) for p in obj["control_params"])==[("index",1,"bit32"),("pkts",2,"bit64")]; assert [(p["name"],p["id"],p["type"],p["value"]) for p in obj["constructor_params"]]==[('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'type'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 1, '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'bit32'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 0)]'"'"'; $TC p4template create table/constructorRules/cb/t1 keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/c1; $TC p4template del table/constructorRules/cb/t1; $TC p4template del extern_inst/constructorRules/DirectCounter/c1; printf constructor_verified'
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/constructorRules 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf "%s\n" "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
